fields.value: Mouse-tracking Individual and Joint Simon Task data

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains behavioural data of recorded movement trajectories in three related psychological tasks: an individual Simon task, an individual GoNo-Go Simon task and a Joint Simon task. These are stimulus-response compatibility tasks typically done using button pressing. The dataset is a result of research that employed mouse-tracking methodology, in which participants execute responses by moving a standard computer mouse and clicking on a corner area of a computer screen. The data include variables that characterise each experimental trial as well as recorded x and y coordinates and their associated timestamps.
